script_text: You've been dreaming of the same animal for three nights. That is not random. The Moon rules you — water element, keeper of instinct — and Saturn sits retrograde at 7 degrees Aries in your 1st House, stripping your instincts bare. Venus at 8 degrees Scorpio in your 8th House trines Jupiter at 13 degrees Cancer in your 4th: love turns domestic and permanent, and someone's family claims you. In career, Mars in your 8th House pushes money through other people's hands, so a commission or partner's bonus lands, but Jupiter square Saturn says wait for tomorrow's direct station before you sign. Shadow side: Chiron retrograde in your 1st House exposes the wound of trusting instinct, while your North Node in Aquarius demands you serve the pack, not the ego. At dawn, name your animal aloud, then walk nine minutes in silence. Comment your sign and follow for tomorrow's station.
